title: Quaid-e-Azam House
visualBrief: Whole named surviving two-storey Quaid-e-Azam main house: original26vertex native outline including projecting central porch and rear wings; yellow limestone/rusticated plinth, twin front three-arch bays on both levels, open recessed loggias with physical columns/arches, green louvered fanlights and timber glazed screens, paired projecting round stone balconies, central green gabled porch, separate tiled hips/caps and rear/side walls/roof volumes. Detached annexe/auditorium, out-houses, offices/garages/guards/kitchen, garden fountain and grounds are separate and excluded. Use recessed rooms/screens behind real open loggia arches; keep paired3arch bays, segmented stone archivolts, fluted corner piers and simplified capitals, green louvered fanlights/wooden screens, round cantilevered balustrade balconies with scalloped bowl supports, central green timber gabled porch/physical fretwork, distinct hipped red tile roof/cap. Native foot outline supplies all lower wall courses; no parcel rectangle or fountain. Photograph controls visible front; roof/side/rear census and dimensions explicitly bounded. Freeze independent field first.
